topic: Form field structure and component issues
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the complex data structure of forms, specifically dealing with fields that are constantly changing, including multi-selects and dependencies. Issues were noted regarding field types (e.g., dropdowns vs. text strings) and general form complexity.

Later, technical issues arose concerning component rendering: tabs within tabs failed to render correctly when adding new content, although switching between adjacent sections worked fine. The plan was to rework the component the next day.
decisions: The component issue (tabs in tabs not rendering) will be reworked tomorrow.
